text: agent1, agent2: I (agent3) propose these APIs. All money in integer cents; percents in basis points (8.25% = 825, 10% = 1000). pricing.get_unit_price_cents(sku) -> int or None if unknown. pricing.get_customer(cid) -> {"name": str, "discount_bp": int} or None if unknown. tax.compute(customer_id, subtotal_cents, discount_cents) -> (rate_bp, tax_cents); unknown customer -> (0, 0). Logged as topic module_api in the agreement log. Please accept or object.

agent2: I objected to TAX_API v1, MONEY_REPRESENTATION v1 and module_api v1 because of the gaps described above. The log will not accept TAX_API v2 while v1 is open. Proposal: agent1 and agent3, please respond to the open v1 topics so we can close them. Concretely, I want the commit to be v2 with: tax.compute(region, lines, discount_millis) -> (rate_millis, tax_cents), integer cents, thousandths of a percent. If you prefer a different integer representation, say so, but I need region and per-line categories so exemption rules can stay inside tax.py.

agent1, agent2: I withdrew module_api v1 and proposed module_api v2 in the log. It uses integer cents for money and integer thousandths of a percent for rates (agent2's objection: 8.875%=8875). Key additions: pricing.get_item(sku) -> {unit_price_cents, category} (category is needed: the sample's tax 1.86 = 8.25% of 25.00*0.9 only if D is exempt, so tax.py needs per-line category); pricing.get_customer(cid) -> {name, region, discount_millis} or None; tax.compute(region, lines, discount_millis) -> (rate_millis, tax_cents) with lines=[{category, amount_cents}]. agent1: this changes money from Decimal to integer cents, so please vote on v2. agent2: please vote on v2 and I will accept once it reads right to you.

agent1: I objected to v1 of MONEY_REPRESENTATION, module_api and TAX_API and aborted them via commit (objections present). Now proposed v2: MONEY_REPRESENTATION = integer cents plus integer thousandths-of-percent (10% = 10000, 8.875% = 8875), and module_api v2 for pricing (get_item returns name/category/unit_price_cents; get_customer returns region and discount_pm). agent2: please propose TAX_API v2 using these units (the open slot is free now). Please vote on MONEY v2 and module_api v2.

agent1, agent2: I (agent3) accepted MONEY_REPRESENTATION v2 and module_api v2 (agent1's versions in the log). I withdrew my earlier v1 proposals. invoice.py will call: pricing.get_item(sku) -> {name, category, unit_price_cents} or None; pricing.get_customer(cid) -> {id, name, region, discount_pm} or None; tax.compute(region, lines, discount_pm) -> (rate_pm, tax_cents), with lines = [{"category": str, "amount_cents": int}] for known items only, amounts before discount and tax. agent2: please propose TAX_API v2 with exactly this signature (or tell us what changes), and whether it returns the rate as well as the tax. Note the sample tax 1.86 = 8.25% of (25.00 minus 10%) only if D (7.05) is exempt, so tax.py must apply the discount to the taxable base as in your v1 rule.

agent2: I accept MONEY_REPRESENTATION v2 and module_api v2. I corrected my own arithmetic: 10% = 10000 thousandths of a percent, so TAX_API v2 is now (region, lines, discount_pm) -> (rate_pm, tax_cents), with all money and percents as ints. Please vote on TAX_API v2 (it is open now). Once all three accept, we commit all three topics. Note for invoice.py: call tax.compute(region, lines, discount_pm) and show tax_cents / 100 formatted to 2 decimals.

agent1: pricing.py is done in my repo, following the committed module_api v2 and MONEY_REPRESENTATION v2. get_item(sku) returns {sku, name, category, unit_price_cents} or None; get_customer(cid) returns {id, name, region, discount_pm} or None (discount_pm = whole CSV percent * 1000). Lookups return copies. Smoke-tested against data_pricing/.

agent3: invoice.py is done, following the committed MONEY_REPRESENTATION v2, module_api v2 and TAX_API v2. It calls pricing.get_customer, pricing.get_item and tax.compute(region, lines, discount_pm) exactly as committed. It matched the sample output using stub modules. Unknown customer: region None, discount 0.

agent2: tax.py is done in my repo and follows the committed TAX_API v2 / MONEY_REPRESENTATION v2 exactly. Entry point: tax.compute(region, lines, discount_pm) -> (rate_pm, tax_cents). lines = [(category, amount_cents), ...]. Returns (0, 0) when the region is unknown or None, the rate is 0, or nothing is taxable. Exempt categories come from data_tax/exempt_categories.csv. Non-int input raises TypeError. Out-of-range discount raises ValueError. Scratch checks pass (14/14).
